entries.candidate: CyrusOne Chandler campus PHX1-PHX8 (2305-2705 S Ellis St, Chandler AZ; eight data centers on an 85-acre site, 169 MW total IT capacity per CyrusOne)
entries.reason: Not in the Atlas. CyrusOne's Chandler back-up generator schedule page (sitemap lastmod 7 August 2026; captured 26 October 2026) describes the campus as 'comprised of 8 data centers on an 85-acre site' and announces generator runs on 11, 19 and 20 August and 1 September 2026 during substation maintenance 'to provide safe working conditions for critical electrical switchgear operations'; the campus page (captured 26 October 2026; Internet Archive copies of 7 February, 13 May, 14 July and 8 October 2026) lists eight facilities, 2,000,000 sq ft and 169 MW with a 24x7 staffed NOCC but carries no date. The generator page has no Internet Archive copy, so its August update cannot be bounded to the 85-day window (it may predate 2 August), a generator-testing notice is indirect evidence of operation, and the undated campus page cannot establish an observation date. No campus parcel locator was completed: the Maricopa owner query for CyrusOne entities returns only a 16.2-acre CYRUSONE TRS INC parcel in Chandler (303-36-270, no situs address, deed of 1 July 2026), not the S Ellis St campus parcels.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window CyrusOne statement of Chandler operations (or a generator-schedule update bounded by an archived copy) plus Maricopa assessor parcels at 2305-2705 S Ellis St identified by situs address (select company-owned parcels only).
